verdict.rationale: Marqeta's documented Agentic AI MCP Server explicitly names AI agents as the use case, combining instant-issue virtual card issuance with customizable velocity limits, spending caps, and merchant restrictions — directly matching the story of scoped agent cards with merchant locks and amount caps. This is backed by dedicated first-party documentation (not just generic issuing docs) plus the underlying Core API primitives (authorization/velocity controls, card creation) that implement these locks. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that an agent can actually complete this flow end-to-end, and explicit documentation of expiry-based scoping specifically for agent cards.
